body.name: InputI
body.def: \(I=(G^{+},G_H^{[]},H,A,a,Y,p_H)\) contains the retained normalized structural expansion and the observed latent-projection LS-ADMMG/CADMG \(G_H^{[]}=\operatorname{latentProjection}_V(G_H^N)\), together with the query, fixed selector support, and supplied finite observed table. Every LGS graphical computation uses \(G_H^{[]}\); \(G^{+}\) remains only the source for normalization and polynomial semantics.
